# Tooltip

> A short description that shows up beside an element on hover and focus.

`<slab-tooltip>` · Overlays · built on `[role=tooltip]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/tooltip/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/tooltip.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-tooltip>
  <button slot="anchor">Save</button>
  <span>Saves a copy to your account</span>
</slab-tooltip>
```

## Keyboard

| Key    | What it does                                                                  |
| ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tab    | Focusing the anchor opens the tooltip at once. Leaving it closes the tooltip. |
| Escape | Closes the tooltip.                                                           |

## Elements

### `<slab-tooltip>`

Import `slab-elements/tooltip.js` to register it.

A tooltip with no visual styles: `[role=tooltip]` content, shown in the top layer beside the element slotted as its `anchor`.

It opens when the anchor is hovered, after `open-delay`, and at once when the anchor is focused. It closes when the pointer leaves, after `close-delay`, when the anchor loses focus, and on Escape. The pointer can cross from the anchor onto the tooltip without it closing, so its content can be read at any zoom, which is what WCAG 1.4.13 asks of content shown on hover.

The anchor is described by the tooltip's content. ARIA references can't cross a shadow root, so the content is slotted rather than rendered: it stays in the anchor's tree, and the anchor's `aria-describedby` points at it. A Slab anchor, such as a Copy Button, passes that on to the element in its shadow root that has focus.

It's placed beside its anchor with CSS anchor positioning, as Popover is, and flipped when it would leave the screen. `placement` picks the side and nothing else: the gap, the alignment, and every other visual choice are left to `::part(tooltip)`. Where anchor positioning isn't supported, the tooltip falls back to the browser's centering.

Style it through its `tooltip` part and `:state(open)`.

#### Attributes

| Name          | Type                                     | Default    | Description                                                                        |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `close-delay` | `number`                                 | `200`      | How many milliseconds it waits after the pointer and focus leave before it closes. |
| `disabled`    | `boolean`                                | `false`    | The tooltip doesn't open and doesn't describe its anchor.                          |
| `open-delay`  | `number`                                 | `300`      | How many milliseconds the pointer rests on the anchor before it opens.             |
| `open`        | `boolean`                                | `false`    | Whether it's open. Set it to open or close it.                                     |
| `placement`   | `'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'top'` | `'bottom'` | The side of its anchor it opens on, when there's room. It flips when there isn't.  |

#### Methods

| Signature                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `hide(): void`                     | Closes it at once, without waiting for `close-delay`.                                                                                                                              |
| `show(): void`                     | Opens it at once, without waiting for `open-delay`. It doesn't open while it's disabled.                                                                                           |
| `toggle(force?: boolean): boolean` | Opens it when it's closed, and closes it when it's open, as a native popover's `togglePopover()` does. `true` only opens it and `false` only closes it. Returns whether it's open. |

#### Events

| Name           | Type          | Description                                                                                                          |
| -------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toggle`       | `ToggleEvent` | When it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` with `oldState` and `newState` that doesn't bubble, as a popover's does. |
| `beforetoggle` | `ToggleEvent` | Before it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` that doesn't bubble. Cancel it while it's opening to keep it closed.   |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type      | Description                                                           |
| --------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `anchor`  | `Element` | The element the tooltip is for. It should be one that can be focused. |
| (default) | `Element` | The tooltip's content, which describes the anchor                     |

#### CSS parts

| Name      | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `tooltip` | The tooltip |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description          |
| ------------------ | -------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled. |
| `:state(open)`     | While it's open.     |
